# Marchant Farm

> Marchant Farm is a private farm estate located at 55 Chestnut Woods Rd in Redding, CT, offering a venue for unforgettable gatherings. The farm also provides a selection of local agricultural goods and supplies.

## Services
### Farmer's Market
- Honey — $14.00
- Eggs — $5.00
- Vegetables
- Seasonal Fruits

### Firewood
- Firewood By The Bag — $10.00
- Firewood By The Pallet

### Offers
- Marchant Farm Horse Show Series 2026
- Yoga on the Farm

### Signature
- Honey
- Eggs
